extracted.intended_audience: Investigators preparing an NIH PHS-398 (RFA-AI-18-042) grant application (PD/PIs, administrative leads, and budget personnel)
extracted.subtask_description: Preparing and completing an NIH PHS-398 modular grant application (including biosketches, research plan/Specific Aims, vertebrate animal disclosure, modular budget, consortium justification, and required supplemental sections) for response to RFA-AI-18-042.

rubrics_metrics.name: Biographical Sketch length limit
rubrics_metrics.description: BIOGRAPHICAL SKETCH DO NOT EXCEED FIVE PAGES.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include Personal Statement, Positions and Employment, Other Experience and Professional Memberships, Honors, Contribution to Science, and Complete List of Published Work as appropriate within the five-page limit (examples of content appear in the sample biosketches).

rubrics_metrics.name: Vertebrate Animals Section — euthanasia and methods
rubrics_metrics.description: Are vertebrate animals euthanized? If 'Yes' — Is the method consistent with American Veterinary Medical Association (AVMA) guidelines? If 'No' to AVMA guidelines, describe method and provide scientific justification.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants must explicitly answer whether vertebrate animals are euthanized and, when applicable, state consistency with AVMA guidelines or provide justification for deviations in the Vertebrate Animals section (file: vertebrate_animals1053682470.pdf).

rubrics_metrics.name: Program Income reporting
rubrics_metrics.description: *Is program income anticipated during the periods for which the grant support is requested? (Yes/No).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If 'Yes', use the provided format to reflect Budget Period, Anticipated Amount ($), and Source(s). If 'No', leave the section blank. (Marked as 'Program Income Section' on the PHS 398 Cover Page Supplement.)

rubrics_metrics.name: Human Embryonic Stem Cells (hESC) disclosure
rubrics_metrics.description: *Does the proposed project involve human embryonic stem cells? (Yes/No).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If 'Yes', list the registration number(s) of the specific cell line(s) from the NIH registry or, if a specific line cannot be referenced, check the box indicating that one from the registry will be used. (See registry: http://grants.nih.gov/stem_cells/registry/current.htm.)

rubrics_metrics.name: Inventions and Patents reporting (renewal applications)
rubrics_metrics.description: Inventions and Patents: (Yes/No). If the answer is 'Yes' then answer the following: Previously Reported: (Yes/No).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Renewal applications must disclose inventions and patents and indicate whether they were previously reported; provide required details in the Inventions and Patents section.

rubrics_metrics.name: Change of Investigator / Institution reporting
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide information for Change of Project Director/Principal Investigator or Change of Grantee Institution (including name of former PD/PI and fields for new PD/PI and former institution).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When proposing a change of PD/PI or grantee institution, complete the Cover Page Supplement fields for prior PD/PI name and former institution and provide required supporting information.

rubrics_metrics.name: Required Research Plan components (PHS 398 Research Plan)
rubrics_metrics.description: The Research Plan must include: Introduction (for Resubmission and Revision applications), Specific Aims, Research Strategy, Progress Report Publication List, Vertebrate Animals, Select Agent Research, Multiple PD/PI Leadership Plan, Consortium/Contractual Arrangements, Letters of Support, Resource Sharing Plan(s), Authentication of Key Biological and/or Chemical Resources, and Appendix.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Each listed component corresponds to a separate file or section (e.g., strategy1053974460.pdf, vertebrate_animals1053682470.pdf, leadership_plan1053682469.pdf, consortium_language1053682473.pdf, resource_sharing_plan1053974453.pdf, auth_key_resources1053682471.pdf). Applicants must supply the required documents and address each topic fully in the Research Plan.

rubrics_metrics.name: PHS 398 Modular Budget format and required fields
rubrics_metrics.description: Modular Budget must report for each Budget Period: A. Direct Costs (Funds Requested; Direct Cost less Consortium Indirect (F&A); Consortium Indirect (F&A); Total Direct Costs), B. Indirect (F&A) Costs (Type, Rate %, Base $ , Funds Requested), C. Total Direct and Indirect (A + B); and include Cognizant Agency name/POC and Indirect (F&A) Rate Agreement Date.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Budget Periods 1–5 and cumulative budget information must be completed. Provide indirect cost rate, base, rates, and identify the cognizant agency contact (example: DHHS, Janet Turner; Indirect (F&A) Rate Agreement Date).

rubrics_metrics.name: Personnel Justification
rubrics_metrics.description: Justify personnel roles, percent effort, and how effort is allocated; state that budget request covers only expenses explicitly related to the project and that there is no overlap with other sources of support.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List Senior/Key Personnel and Other Personnel with title, percent effort (e.g., Co-PI 17% effort), explicit responsibilities (supervision, data generation, analysis, mentorship), and requested salary/tuition support. Include graduate student effort, number of months, and tuition remission requested. Provide Personnel Justification document (personnel_justification...pdf).

rubrics_metrics.name: Consortium Justification
rubrics_metrics.description: Explain inclusion of subcontractors/collaborators: why the subcontract is essential, the unique expertise they bring, and how their participation is necessary to execute the proposal.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide specific statements on subcontract roles (e.g., FAU/Nimmerjahn provides internationally-recognized immunology expertise, experimental methods, in vivo models and integration with computational work), estimated costs (per year and total over project), personnel involved and their effort, and why inclusion furthers NIH goals more effectively than domestic alternatives.

rubrics_metrics.name: Additional Narrative Justification — Graduate Student Remission & Indirect Costs
rubrics_metrics.description: Request for Graduate Student Researcher fee remission for specified academic quarters and provide assumptions for tuition inflation; state the indirect cost rate and definition of Modified Total Direct Costs (MTDC).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specify number of quarters/years for GSR remission, anticipated tuition inflation rate (example: 3% annual), and define MTDC (total direct costs minus graduate student non-resident tuition and fee remissions for two students) used for indirect cost calculations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Specific Aims content and structure
rubrics_metrics.description: Specific Aims should state the problem/background, present a hypothesis, and list discrete aims (e.g., Aim 1, Aim 2) with clear objectives and sub-tasks to test the hypothesis.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A Specific Aims page should concisely introduce importance and rationale, articulate hypotheses, and enumerate aims with bullet points describing the experiments/measurements and expected validation steps (examples given: Aim 1 — validate multivalent binding model; Aim 2 — map human and murine IgG isotypes).

rubrics_metrics.name: Research Support reporting
rubrics_metrics.description: List Ongoing and Completed Research Support: include grant number (when applicable), project title, project dates, role (PI/Co-PI), and a short description of the project's goals and relevance.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For each support entry (ongoing or completed), indicate role (e.g., Role: PI, Co-PI), funding period, and concise description of aims and how the support relates to the current application (examples shown for NIH U01-CA215709, NIH DP5-OD019815, etc.).

rubrics_metrics.name: Appendix and resource authentication requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Include an Appendix if needed and provide an Authentication of Key Biological and/or Chemical Resources section.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Appendix materials are listed as an allowed attachment (12. Appendix). Authentication must address key reagents and resources (file: auth_key_resources1053682471.pdf) to assure reproducibility.

rubrics_metrics.name: Cover Page Supplement required disclosures
rubrics_metrics.description: The PHS 398 Cover Page Supplement requires answers/disclosures for Vertebrate Animals, Program Income, Human Embryonic Stem Cells, Inventions and Patents, Change of Investigator/Institution, etc.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Complete the Cover Page Supplement fields (e.g., checkboxes and follow-up details) and include tracking and funding opportunity identifiers (example: Funding Opportunity Number: RFA-AI-18-042; Tracking Number: GRANT12779839).
